newsitem.title: UK: NWE NAPHTHA FIRMS AFTER TRADER BUYING, MOGAS GAINS.
newsitem.headline: NWE NAPHTHA FIRMS AFTER TRADER BUYING, MOGAS GAINS.

text.p: NWE naphtha was talked stronger on Wednesday following a couple of deals done on Tuesday.
Two cargoes traded yesterday at $197.00 and $197.25 cif NWE.
Some traders said the levels were overdone and that the market was really around $193-194.00 a tonne.
Swaps on Wednesday for the balance of August shuffled around $192.50-$194.00 with a steep backwardation of $5 or so into September still evident.
"I can't see any reason why physical naphtha should be so much stronger than swaps - where's the fundemental change from Monday?" asked one dealer.
